flight_simulate — DRIVE ball op

• 数据种类:table × table → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.flight_simulate(p0, v0, omega, bp: 'dict', ip: 'dict', t_end: 'float', dt: 'float' = 0.001, table_z: 'float' = 0.0, table_xy=None, max_bounces: 'int' = 100, v_rest: 'float' = 0.001) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import ballistics; ballistics.flight_simulate(p0, v0, omega, bp: 'dict', ip: 'dict', t_end: 'float', dt: 'float' = 0.001, table_z: 'float' = 0.0, table_xy=None, max_bounces: 'int' = 100, v_rest: 'float' = 0.001) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("flight_simulate"))

用法

将飞行与在球台上(平面 z = table_z，仅在 table_xy = (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) 范围内)的弹跳连接起来，接触时刻用二分法在区间内求出。返回值 {"t", "p", "v", "omega" (N, 3), "contacts": [{"t", "p", "v_in", "v_out", "omega_in", "omega_out", "regime"}], "rest_t"}。球半径为 r，因此球心到达 table_z + r 处即为接触。弹跳会无限持续(Zeno)，所以当接触时 |v_n| < v_rest 时把球放在台面上(此后 z 固定，水平方向无摩擦继续运动；rest_t = 该时刻，若无则为 None)。
